name: claude-code-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: plugins that change how Claude Code itself behaves.

plugins.name: dictation-cleanup
plugins.description: Cleans dictated prompts before they are sent: filler words, spoken quotation marks, project names spelled as the project's docs spell them, and a Haiku pass for longer messages.

plugins.name: tool-output-diet
plugins.description: Trims shell output before Claude reads it: colour codes, overwritten progress-bar frames and long runs of identical lines. Nothing else is touched.

plugins.name: no-ai-trailers
plugins.description: Keeps the Claude co-author trailer and the Generated-with footer out of your commits and pull requests.

plugins.name: studio-state
plugins.description: Gives Claude a studio_state tool for a studio-layout video repository: one compact answer on where a video project stands. Silent in every other folder.
